title: Swatantra Bharadwaj escapes police net, flees Bulandshahr on Bullet; manhunt launched
content: Swatantra Bharadwaj, accused of assaulting a student's father, evaded arrest in Bulandshahr. Delhi Police had assured CJP of his arrest within seventy-two hours. The accused claimed to have cracked the victim's skull during a Jantar Mantar protest. CJP demanded stricter charges and action against the accused for alleged threats. Police also promised an FIR for online abuse targeting the student.

title: Heavy rain lashes parts of Delhi-NCR; IMD issues red alert, flights ops hit
content: Heavy rainfall and thunderstorms struck Delhi on Friday, leading the India Meteorological Department to declare a red alert for extreme weather. The violent downpour interrupted Janmashtami celebrations across the region. Forecasts suggest light to moderate showers will continue into the evening, with strong winds gusting up to 60 kmph enhancing the stormy conditions.

title: Seatbelt sign off, pilot tests positive for drugs: What Air India flight probe found
content: An Air India flight faced serious challenges with multiple hydraulic failures and altitude disturbances. Following the incident, the pilot-in-command tested non-negative for psycho-active substances. Passengers sustained injuries, and the aircraft suffered considerable cabin damage. After evaluating the situation, the crew chose to proceed to Delhi. The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau is diligently examining all aspects of this alarming event.

title: 'They change their mind like pants': Jason Gillespie tears into Pakistan cricket
content: Pakistan replaced head coach Sarfaraz Ahmed and bowling coach Umar Gul, while also sending seven players home after losing the first two Tests at Headingley and Lord's.

title: Uber layoffs: 3,300 jobs cut using two moves straight from Amazon's playbook
content: Uber is laying off 3,300 employees, about 10% of its global workforce, as CEO Dara Khosrowshahi flattens management layers and tightens office rules. The restructuring copies two moves from Amazon CEO Andy Jassy's playbook: raising the individual contributor to manager ratio, and pulling remote staff back to hubs. Unlike Amazon, Meta and Block, Khosrowshahi did not blame AI.

title: 'I chanted Hare Krishna for 9 days': Nepal worker rescued from tunnel on Janmashtami
content: A worker rescued after nine days chanted the Hare Krishna mantra for survival. Sanjay Sah stayed back to ensure others escaped the disaster upstream. He communicated with a few nearby workers while trapped in darkness. Two workers were rescued alive, and search operations continue for others. Flash floods triggered by an ice-rock avalanche devastated towns and villages.

title: From basketball- & boxing-obsessed nation, Alex Eala is creating a fandom of her own
content: Alex Eala's phenomenal performance at the US Open is not only thrilling fans but also transforming the landscape of sports in the Philippines. Having reached the third round, her journey of historic victories and a rise to world number eighteen has sparked a wave of enthusiasm. The 'Laban Alex' movement embodies the surge of national pride surrounding her inspiring achievements.

title: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith’s message to international students: Study, then return home
content: Alberta's Premier Danielle Smith has made it clear that international students need to leave Canada once their study visas expire. She highlighted that these visas serve as temporary permits meant for academic pursuits, urging students to return to their home countries. This statement follows rising concerns over immigration programs misleading students about potential residency outcomes. With Canada tightening its immigration policies, unauthorized work could lead to serious repercussions.

title: Las Vegas crossing guard steps in front of car to protect mother and children
content: In a heart-stopping moment, a crossing guard in Las Vegas, Richard Jones, heroically leapt into action to save a mother and her children from an oncoming vehicle near Pinecrest Academy St. Rose. The shocking dashcam footage revealed how close they came to disaster. Grateful for his bravery, the family later returned to express their heartfelt thanks, emphasizing the inherent dangers faced by crossing guards in school zones.

title: Former Ravens coach John Harbaugh's 1905 Maryland stone mansion sells for $6M
content: Former Baltimore Ravens coach John Harbaugh has sold his historic stone mansion in Owings Mills, Maryland, for $6 million. He bought the 9-acre property for $3 million in 2013. Built in 1905, the 9,100-square-foot home has five bedrooms, a carriage house, four-car garage, pool, hot tub and multiple outdoor spaces.

title: iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max & Fold launch on Sept 9: Expected India price & features
content: On September 9th, Apple is set to unveil the much-anticipated iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. In a groundbreaking move, the tech giant is also expected to introduce its first foldable iPhone, with rumors indicating a significant price hike for both the Pro series and the foldable model due to rising component costs. Additionally, new iterations of the Apple Watch and AirPods are likely to be announced during this event.

title: ‘Feel the power!’ Swatantra Bhardwaj's Instagram story after assaulting protester
content: Delhi Police denied claims of political influence in a Jantar Mantar protest violence case.  An accused man bragged about injuring another protester due to political connections.  Police stated legal action was taken and a chargesheet will be filed soon.  The injured man sustained a head injury during a scuffle at the protest.  The incident occurred on June 23rd during a CJP protest at Jantar Mantar.

title: Gadkari clears Rs 5,000 IIT-Delhi fix for old vehicles; can cut pollution by 90%
content: Speaking at an event organised by the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (Siam), Gadkari said the technology, developed from an innovation at IIT-Delhi, had successfully completed testing. The devices can be fitted on BS-IV, BS-III and older diesel vehicles, bringing their emissions to levels comparable with BS-VI vehicles.

title: Parents sold gold for Rahul Mehta's US education; he later funded 8 IIT schools
content: Rahul Mehta left Mumbai for the US at 17, funded by his parents selling their gold and silver. He built and sold four companies without venture capital, then decided by 2006 he had "enough." Since then, through the Bhupat and Jyoti Mehta Family Foundation, he has funded schools and programmes at IITs in biotechnology, AI, data science and sustainability, aiming to produce 12,000 graduates by 2031 — believing time and talent matter as much as money.

title: 'Will handle my case on my own': Pocso case undertrial flees from hospital washroom in burqa
content: A woman undertrial has mysteriously fled from Bareilly district hospital, evading the watch of two constables. Reports suggest she managed to don a burqa in the restroom, slipping away without detection. The constables’ failure to secure her has led to their suspension by the SSP. Authorities are currently analyzing CCTV footage and coordinating search efforts to locate her, with an FIR filed for her escape from lawful custody.

title: Watch: Stray dogs save mentally ill woman from sexual assault attempt in Coimbatore
content: Stray dogs intervened to save a mentally ill woman from an alleged assault. An intoxicated youth approached the woman near Thudiyalur in Coimbatore early Friday. The dogs barked and bit the attacker, forcing him to flee the scene. Police identified and arrested the suspect following the incident. CCTV footage captured the entire event, aiding the investigation.

title: Janmashtami remedies: 5 Krishna-focused rituals & acts; for harmony, clarity in life
content: Janmashtami 2026 heralds a time of potent cosmic energies fostering familial harmony and emotional balance. Astrological guidance encourages engaging in specific rites to boost spiritual enlightenment, such as lighting diyas, inscribing the names of Lord Krishna, and self-reflection. Notably, this period is ideal for investing in a child's education, given Jupiter's beneficial presence, while couples can deepen their connection through a shared jhula sankalp ritual.

title: Seven wickets in 21 balls: SL captain scripts history with record-breaking spell
content: Sri Lanka were defending a modest target of 125 on a slow-paced pitch, but Athapaththu turned the match around with one of the best bowling performances in women's T20 internationals.

title: 'Swatantra to be arrested in 72 hours': CJP protester and daughter of assault victim
content: Nishu Azad stated Delhi Police promised action against Swatantra Bhardwaj within seventy-two hours.  Protesters gathered demanding strict action over an alleged assault at Jantar Mantar.  A viral podcast clip intensified outrage regarding the incident and alleged political connections.  Bhardwaj denied assault, claiming self-defense against a mob surrounding him.  Police confirmed a case registered and individuals questioned, rejecting claims of interference.

title: Samson-Sooryavanshi to open? Ex-India cricketer suggests new opening combination
content: In an exciting update, Sanju Samson has been reintegrated into India's T20I squad for the upcoming Afghanistan series. Deep Dasgupta, the former player, has recommended experimenting with a batting partnership of Samson and the talented Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who caught the selectors' eye during the Zimbabwe series. Dasgupta stresses that exploring combinations is vital for India's preparations ahead of the World Cup.

title: The long game: Inside MLB's big bet on India's baseball future
content: Major League Baseball (MLB) is taking the long road in India, betting on grassroots participation, cricket's massive ecosystem and a new generation of young players rather than rushing towards a professional league. Since 2019, it has introduced the First Pitch programme in schools across Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru, launched the MLB Cup youth tournament and produced India-focused documentaries to make baseball feel more relatable.

title: ‘Taken to a room, beaten’: YouTubers allege assault at Saket station, cops deny
content: Two women YouTubers allege police personnel beat them at Saket police station. Police deny these allegations, stating the women obstructed a security route. The women reportedly argued and manhandled a pregnant officer during the incident. They were taken to the station but allowed to leave shortly after. Police maintain the women were not restrained and chose not to depart.

title: Meet Shruti Dhariwal, the Indian innovator shaping how kids learn AI
content: Shruti Dhariwal, an Indian researcher and MIT Media Lab doctoral alumna, is exploring how children can move beyond simply using AI to creating and experimenting with it. After studying computer science and management in India and developing educational games at MadRat Games, Dhariwal joined MIT, where she researched creative learning, coding and play. Her current work centres on CoCo, a co-creative computing and AI education platform designed to help children and teenagers learn collaboratively while developing creativity and critical thinking.

title: Not given FIR copy, says ex-bureaucrat Ashish Joshi; no need at this stage, say cops
content: In a surprising turn of events, former bureaucrat Ashish Joshi was interrogated by Delhi Police about a social media post related to election officials. During this process, he requested a copy of the FIR linked to the Bharatiya Nyay Sanhita law. Joshi expressed concern about being unable to inform his family about the interrogation, but police maintained that they adhered to legal requirements during the inquiry.

title: 4 killed as bus collides with moped in Tamil Nadu
content: Four young girls died tragically after a college bus collided with their moped. The victims included three sisters and their cousin returning from school. Two girls died instantly, while the other two succumbed en route to the hospital. The bus driver has since surrendered to the police. Authorities have registered a case and are investigating the fatal accident.

title: 'Cracked skull': CJP seeks arrest of 'influencer' over assault on student's father
content: The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) marched to Parliament Street Police Station demanding action. They allege Swatantra Bhardwaj assaulted protesters at Jantar Mantar during a peaceful demonstration. Bhardwaj himself admitted to the assault in a widely shared video online. The CJP highlighted the victim's injuries and the alleged caste angle involved. They questioned the Delhi Police's inaction despite the influencer's public confession.

title: FBI adds India-origin man Manjit Singh Bedi to most-wanted fraudsters list
content: The FBI has placed Manjit Singh Bedi on its most-wanted list due to accusations of fraudulent activities amounting to over $600,000 in government benefits. Allegedly exploiting customer EBT cards for cash instead of food, Bedi fled to Canada and then to India following criminal charges. A significant reward is being offered by the FBI for any information that could lead to his capture.

title: Why Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman chose Goa after retiring from IAF
content: Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman has taken premature retirement from the Indian Air Force. He is now training abroad to fly ATR 72-600 turboprop aircraft. Abhinandan will reportedly operate flights for regional airline FLY91 in Goa. The airline welcomes many defense officers for their second careers. FLY91 recently ordered forty ATR 72-600 aircraft globally.

title: Watch: Man boasts of 'cracking skull' of CJP protester's father at Jantar Mantar
content: Political tensions rise as opposition parties lash out at the BJP following an influencer's claims of political support. The influencer reportedly assaulted the father of a student protester at Jantar Mantar, leading to criticism. While Delhi Police reported only minor injuries, opposition leaders express concern over the investigation, suggesting political meddling. In response, the CJP has called for a protest to demand accountability for the influencer's actions.

title: Play, deport, repeat: Trump launches arcade-style immigration games
content: The White House has introduced online games with a "MAGA" theme to promote immigration policies. Players can engage in activities like deporting migrants and building a border wall. One game, Rio Run, features a border official chasing migrants along the Rio Grande. Another game, Build the Wall, involves stacking blocks to construct a border barrier. These games aim to communicate administration policies through entertainment and social media platforms.

title: Ganesh mandal worker slaps anti-noise campaigner in Pune
content: An anti-noise campaigner was assaulted on Tilak Road in Pune. The accused, Santosh Chavan, president of Janjagruti Pratishthan, was arrested by police. This incident occurred amid ongoing debates about Ganeshotsav sound system usage. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condemned the violence and stressed peaceful dialogue. Police have provided security to the assaulted campaigner.

title: Meet Priyansh Agarwal, Class 12 student who built AI to analyse his tennis game
content: Class 12 student and national-level tennis player Priyansh Agarwal developed TennEdge, an AI-powered motion-sensing system designed to help tennis players analyse swing speed, accuracy, power and spin. Inspired by his experience in competitive tennis and sports technology, he explored wearable sensors to collect performance data without affecting racket balance. The project also led to Skill Bridge, an initiative promoting practical technical and vocational learning. Agarwal aims to make sports analytics more accessible to young and amateur players.

title: Protein, creatine never delivered; customer gets refund plus Rs 50,000 compensation
content: A Himachal Pradesh consumer commission ordered Muscle Beast to refund Rs 7,875. The company failed to deliver protein and creatine supplements after receiving payment.  The customer Davesh Duvedi approached the commission after repeated failed delivery assurances.  The commission also awarded Rs 30,000 for mental harassment and Rs 20,000 for litigation.  Muscle Beast must pay the refund and compensation within thirty days.

After a Rs. 101.10 crore opening, the film witnessed a steady slowdown but remains close to the Rs. 250 crore India net milestone.
